The level-up screen's row list is game/data/progression/attributes.json (TEN ids: strength endurance agility speed vigour willpower intellect hist-bond personality luck). The DEFAULT character (sim/state.js:214) has SIX and they are Souls names: vigour endurance strength dexterity intelligence faith. So dexterity/intelligence/faith are NOT on the screen and cannot be raised, while 7 of the 10 rows show a constant 10 for an attribute the character does not have, and confirming one MINTS it at 11.

READ-PHASE F2: the builder's own headline artifact reports_runs/W1-13-R2/levelling-loop.json shows this happening: hearth-archon raised endurance (real), hearth-lilmoth raised AGILITY (new key), hearth-gideon raised SPEED (new key). Two of the three demonstration spends bought an attribute the character did not have, and both were scored pass:true with souls_matches_cost:true.

SPEED IS NAMED BY NOTHING - no pool, no reaction, no faction gate, no quest requirement. Souls spent on speed buy a level number and nothing else.
